title: The two constant one-bit inputs differ
statement: The two functions from the singleton $\{0\}$ to $\{0,1\}$ that are constantly $0$ and constantly $1$ are distinct.
hypotheses_covered: none (unconditional inequality of two explicit functions)
replaced:
The constant-$\mathit{false}$ and constant-$\mathit{true}$ inputs on $\mathrm{Fin}\,1$ are
distinct.
